content:
taylor: Heads-up: planning a quick patch publish for py+ts tonight in the 01:00-02:00 UTC quiet window. Main asks: pin @types, rotate ephemeral token post-publish, and include the tiny deprecation blurb for sync-utils. Who's on watch?

nina: I'll watch. For types pinning I'm proposing we publish types under `types-compat` dist-tag and also set the package.json `types` field explicitly to avoid consumers pulling latest ambient types.

morgan: Agree on pin. Also recommend we run an extra consumer-type check: `yarn workspace example-consumer run tsc --noEmit` in CI before we flip dist-tag. I'll add that quick job.

deploy-bot: preflight: CI main green, smoke 10/10, signing keys available. Artifacts staged at s3://redwood-nightdrops/1719101112.

sam: Runbook snippet for the publish (paste for audit):
```
# dry-run
./bin/publish.sh --packages=py,ts --dry-run --disttag=patch-night
# sign and publish
./bin/publish.sh --packages=py,ts --disttag=patch-night --sign
# pin types
npm dist-tag add @types/redwood@1.2.4 types-compat
# rotate token
aws secretsmanager put-secret-value --secret-id patches/night-token --secret-string "<rotated>"
```

taylor: Rollback triggers: any import error in TS smoke, pip wheel checksum mismatch, or auth failures on publish endpoints. Rollback steps: 1) move dist-tag to previous version `npm dist-tag add redwood@1.2.3 patch-night && npm dist-tag rm redwood patch-night`, 2) yank wheel from our internal pypi proxy and route consumers to the pinned release, 3) open a follow-up thread and notify #integrations.

nina: Also: if we see sudden uptick in type errors from postpublish telemetry, we should consider reverting types only (move `@types/redwood` back) before full rollback.

deploy-bot: publish-preview: artifacts signed, but dist-tag not moved. Checksums OK.

morgan: I'll kick the extra tsc consumer job once the dry-run completes. If green, proceed to sign.

sam: Reminder: ephemeral token must be rotated via the script after publish: `scripts/rotate-night-token.sh` (it writes to SecretsManager and invalidates old token). We want zero long-lived tokens in CI.

docs: Draft release note created at `docs/releases/patch-night-1719101112.md` with deprecation blurb and migration snippet for sync-utils. Please review if wording fine.

taylor: Good. Watch handoff: Nina primary, Morgan runs consumer checks, Sam rotates token post-publish. Timeout: 01:40 UTC for forced rollback if any high-sev.

morgan: Dry-run started. Posting results in ~5m.

(automated deploy-bot publish events and later messages omitted here; will appear as separate short messages in the channel after publish.)
